companyContext: Lidl is a German international discount supermarket chain that operates over 12,000 stores across Europe and the United States. Part of the Schwarz Group, Lidl sells groceries, household goods, and an expanding range of non-food private-label products. Lidl is known for offering quality products at consistently low prices.
brandContext: PARKSIDE is Lidl's private-label brand for tools, garden equipment, and DIY accessories. Named the best-selling DIY brand in Europe by Euromonitor International (2024), PARKSIDE offers a comprehensive range of power tools, hand tools, cordless tool systems (X 12V and X 20V Teams), garden machinery (lawn mowers, hedge trimmers, pressure washers, robotic mowers), and accessories. The brand targets DIY beginners, hobbyists, and enthusiastic home improvers with high-quality products at unbeatable price-performance ratios. For spring and summer DIYers, PARKSIDE provides everything from the first seed planting to garden renovation, patio cleaning, hedge trimming, and outdoor workshop projects. PARKSIDE also offers a higher-tier 'PARKSIDE PERFORMANCE' line for advanced users who need extra power and smart features. The brand's campaign with Arnold Schwarzenegger embodies the 'You Got This!' spirit of empowerment and hands-on accomplishment.

typography.fontUses: Brand name (PARKSIDE wordmark), headings, campaign slogans. Heavy, condensed, uppercase sans-serif used for maximum impact and legibility on packaging, tools, and advertising.
Sub-headings, product names, category labels, call-to-action buttons. Bold sans-serif providing a strong visual hierarchy.
Body text, product descriptions, specifications, and general communications. Clean, legible sans-serif for readability across digital and print.
Fallback / web-safe body text for digital communications, emails, and contexts where the proprietary Lidl Font Pro is unavailable.

brandVision: PARKSIDE's vision is to empower everyone — from first-time DIYers to passionate home improvers — to take matters into their own hands and achieve success in every project around the home, workshop, and garden. The brand is committed to constantly expanding its product range with innovative tools and garden solutions, making high-quality DIY accessible and affordable for all. For spring and summer, PARKSIDE focuses on enabling outdoor projects: garden creation, lawn care, renovation, planting, and alfresco living — turning seasonal ambitions into tangible achievements with the right tools at the best price.
brandValues: Empowerment & Self-Reliance: PARKSIDE believes 'The greatest success is doing it yourself,' inspiring customers to take on projects with confidence. Unbeatable Value: High quality at the best price-performance ratio, making premium DIY accessible to everyone. Reliability & Quality: Every PARKSIDE product undergoes rigorous testing and comes with warranty support, ensuring dependable performance. Innovation: Continuous expansion of cordless battery platforms (X 12V, X 20V), smart-connected tools, and the PARKSIDE Performance line for demanding users. Sustainability: Commitment to eco-friendly practices through the Parkside Eco Line, responsibly sourced materials, and giving things a second life through DIY repair and upcycling. Inclusivity: Tools for everyone — beginners, enthusiasts, and professionals alike — with approachable design and intuitive use. Determination & Action: Embodied by the 'You Got This!' ethos and the Arnold Schwarzenegger partnership, PARKSIDE stands for not overthinking but simply getting started.
